parsed.strategy: Bet on the strongest 90-day analyst revision flow in the evidence: software/internet names with 20-63 net target raises across 17-35 distinct firms (OKTA, SNOW, CRWD, PANW, CRM, GTLB, ESTC, NET, AFRM, DDOG, MDB, WDAY, ZS, S, DT, FTNT), each with a dated print or update inside the Oct 12-Nov 13 window. I ignore target-level upside (measured perverse) and buy the direction of estimate revisions. I would be wrong if the flow is already fully priced: a single high-multiple software guidance cut, a broad AI-capex or rate shock, or a rotation out of momentum software would hit all sixteen names at once, since they share one factor.
